name: waves-shaders-homlu-ui
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Waves style, generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#1A1423, #B75D69, #EACDC2, #FFF5EB). Features: film grain. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
